answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 8 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The pulse chain is verified at intake and opal publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 8 epochs old, anchored at a saffron checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 156 aliases cost 344 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
